name: POS Order Customer Info
description: Easily capture and save customer details in POS orders, display them on receipts, and store them in the backend for better customer tracking.
summary: The POS Order Customer Info module enhances Odoo’s Point of Sale system by enabling businesses to capture and manage customer details directly from the POS interface. This feature is especially useful for retail shops, restaurants, and service providers who want to record essential customer information at the time of sale. Once activated in the POS settings, a Customer Info button appears on the POS main screen. Cashiers can quickly open a popup form to input details such as customer name, address, city, and pincode. The entered information is then stored along with the POS order, ensuring accurate and organized customer records. The module also integrates seamlessly with receipts, printing the captured customer information alongside order details. This not only provides better traceability but also adds a personalized touch to customer interactions. Additionally, the data is saved in the backend and can be accessed from the respective POS order, making it valuable for reporting, after-sales support, and customer relationship management. name: Restrict Payment & POS Features
description: Take full control of your Point of Sale system in Odoo with the POS Payment Restriction & Order Control Module. This powerful extension allows administrators to restrict payment processing, disable order line modifications, prevent unauthorized discounts, and block price changes—ensuring secure and consistent cashier operations.
summary:
The pos_disable_payments module for Odoo provides a robust solution for businesses looking to enhance Point of Sale (POS) security and improve staff control. This module allows administrators to restrict or completely disable specific POS features such as payments, discounts, price and quantity edits, order line deletions, and customer selection. Permissions are highly customizable, enabling control on a per-user or per-employee basis.
With this module, businesses can ensure that sensitive POS functions are only accessible by authorized personnel, reducing the risk of errors, fraud, or unauthorized actions. Features like disabling the numpad and +/- buttons, along with blocking changes to prices and discounts, prevent accidental or malicious alterations.
Ideal for retail stores, restaurants, and any business with multiple cashiers or sensitive POS operations, the pos_disable_payments module enhances accountability by providing a clear audit trail for user actions.
